items.title: Community banks are struggling, crypto isn’t to blame
items.summary: In this clip from the Daily Wolf, Scott Melker sits down with John D’Agostino, head of strategy for Coinbase (COIN) Institutional, to discuss his findings on community banks and crypto. D’Agostino says his research found that none of the community banks he examined connected the rise of crypto with the decline in traditional bank deposits. items.title: MSTR Stock Has Become One of the Market’s Most Unusual Bets
items.summary: MicroStrategy abandoned its original software identity to become a leveraged Bitcoin holding company, and after a brutal 51% collapse over the past year, the question is whether that audacious bet is finally starting to pay off or setting up for something far worse.

items.title: New York sues prediction market Polymarket, calling it an unlicensed gambling operation
items.summary: New York sued the prediction market Polymarket on Thursday, arguing the platform is an unlicensed gambling operation and calling for a judge to block the company from operating in the state.  Prediction market platforms have argued states do not have the authority to govern them because they are regulated at the federal level by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission.  New York officials filed Thursday's lawsuit against Polymarket in state court and want the company to face fines and be forced to pay restitution to users because the platform did not get a gaming license from the state.

items.title: How Much Will One Bitcoin Be Worth in 2031?
